citations.context: In Psalm 39, 2, I was dumb with silence. I held my peace even from good. Even from good I held my peace. This is what you get when you have a religion of fear-based control. In Lamentations 2:10, there's a very strange scene. The elders of the daughter of Zion sit on the ground and keep silence. They have put dust on their heads and girded themselves with sackcloth. The context here is that Jerusalem has fallen. The silence here is the despair, which, yes, you might see after a defeat.
citations.creator: mindshift
citations.title: How Religion Weaponizes Silence | 3 Types of Harm
